description: Non-secret bindings of the isolated Block A verification campaign that the streaming release unit runs (docs/runbooks/edai2/FEATURE_STORE_RUNBOOK.md section 4). Every storage path is derived from the per-build verify-* namespace, so a run never reads or overwrites another run's data. The bucket is the one data_platform/config/dataset_identity.py binds to rehearsal-5gb-v1; the owner supplies the snapshot and feature-run ids named in owner_parameters.
